title: 1. Price integrity across inventory versions
summary: The global V4 calculation works until V5 falls back to parsing a formatted currency string.
failure: V5 displays $22, $17 and $46 instead of $22,448, $17,657 and $46,947. The batch drops from $87,052 to $85 without a JavaScript exception. V6 also double-counts MSRP.
solution: Read structured integer cents, validate the price contract, and write to the version-specific final-price element. Missing prices must not become zero.

title: 2. Layout changes that block commercial actions
summary: Positional CSS written for V4 reaches different elements in V5/V6.
failure: Images are clipped, list rows are compressed, and all three commercial CTA columns inherit pointer-events:none.
solution: Use semantic selectors scoped to the template. Keep pricing rules away from action columns and remove the conflicting global block.

title: 3. Quote the selected unit, not the first result
summary: A fallback to the first document match mixes product identity after a version switch.
failure: In V5, requesting the second CFMOTO at $17,657 creates a demo draft for the first Polaris at $22,448. Nothing is sent.
solution: Resolve the unit from the activated button, require its SKU and structured price, and block drafts when either is missing.

title: 4. One global archive versus version-specific modules
summary: Six current contexts and ten simulated historical implementations live in one global field.
failure: The initial global router works. A shared constant changed for a V4 campaign also changes V5/V6 and Details. Historical functions remain defined but uninvoked.
solution: Save each adaptation with its view/version. Only V4 receives the ATV campaign; other contexts retain their own wording, prices and quote adapters.

title: 5. Details V6: sale price is not the final total
summary: The new product page exposes MSRP, a sale subtotal, delivery charges and a final total. Selecting the wrong amount creates an underquoted draft.
failure: Start My Deal uses the correct stock 3229 but quotes $16,184 instead of the $17,126 total, omitting $942 in destination and assembly charges.
solution: The Details V6 container reads the structured final total in cents while preserving the separate sale-price display.
